values.instruction: Below are short descriptions of different people. For each one, decide how much that person is like you.

quick.text: Coming up with new ideas and doing things in their own original way matters to them.
They want to be wealthy and own expensive things.
They believe everyone in the world should be treated equally and have the same opportunities.
Showing their abilities and being admired for them matters to them.
Living somewhere safe and avoiding anything that could put them in danger is important to them.
They like surprises and are always looking for new things to try.
They think people should follow the rules, even when nobody is watching.
Listening to people who are different from them and understanding their views matters to them.
They try not to draw attention to themselves and prefer to stay modest.
Having a good time and enjoying life's pleasures is important to them.
Making their own decisions and being free to choose what they do matters to them.
Helping the people around them and caring for their wellbeing is very important to them.
Being very successful and having people recognize their achievements matters to them.
They want a strong government that keeps citizens safe from threats.
They seek out adventure and like taking risks.
Behaving properly and avoiding things others would say are wrong is important to them.
They want to be in charge and have others do what they say.
Being loyal to their friends and devoted to the people close to them matters to them.
They firmly believe people should protect nature and care for the environment.
Following the customs and traditions passed down by their family or religion is important to them.
They look for every chance to have fun and do things that give them pleasure.

long.text: Coming up with new ideas and being creative matters to them; they like doing things their own way.
Being rich is important to them; they want lots of money and expensive things.
They think every person in the world should be treated equally and have the same opportunities.
Showing what they can do matters to them; they want people to admire their work.
Living somewhere safe matters to them; they avoid anything that could put them at risk.
They think it's important to do many different things in life, and they always look for something new to try.
They believe people should do as they're told and follow the rules, even when nobody is watching.
Listening to people who are different from them matters; even when they disagree, they want to understand them.
They think people should be content with what they have and not ask for more.
They look for every chance to have fun; doing things that give them pleasure matters to them.
Making their own decisions matters to them; they like being free to plan and choose what they do.
Helping the people around them is very important; they want to look after their wellbeing.
Being very successful matters to them; they like to impress others.
It's very important to them that their country is safe from threats, inside and out.
They like taking risks and are always looking for adventure.
Always behaving properly matters to them; they avoid doing anything people would call wrong.
Being in charge and telling others what to do matters to them; they want people to follow their instructions.
Being loyal to their friends matters; they want to dedicate themselves to the people close to them.
They firmly believe people should care for nature; looking after the environment matters to them.
Their religious or spiritual beliefs are important to them, and they try hard to live by them.
They want things organized and clean; mess really bothers them.
Being curious matters to them; they like trying to understand all kinds of things.
They believe all the world's people should live in harmony, and promoting peace between groups matters to them.
They think being ambitious is important; they want to show how capable they are.
They think traditional ways of doing things are best, and keeping up the customs they learned matters to them.
Enjoying life's pleasures matters to them; they like to treat themselves.
Responding to other people's needs matters to them; they try to support the people they know.
They believe in always showing respect to parents and older people, and being obedient matters to them.
They want everyone treated fairly, even strangers, and protecting the vulnerable in society matters to them.
They like surprises; having an exciting life matters to them.
Staying healthy is very important to them; they work hard to avoid getting sick.
Getting ahead in life matters to them; they try to do better than others.
Forgiving people who have hurt them matters; they try to see the good in them and not hold grudges.
Being independent matters to them; they like to rely on themselves.
A stable government matters to them; they want the social order protected.
Being polite at all times matters to them; they try never to bother or annoy others.
They really want to enjoy life; having a good time is very important to them.
Being humble and modest matters to them; they try not to draw attention to themselves.
They always want to be the one making decisions; they like to lead.
Fitting in with nature matters to them; they believe people shouldn't change the natural world.

motivations.instruction: Rate each statement based on how you usually are, not how you'd like to be.

items.text: Sometimes I may impose my will because I think it's the best way to make things happen.
New experiences and possibilities excite me.
Sometimes I feel that my worth depends on what I achieve.
I often offer my help even before anyone asks for it.
I prefer to say what I think directly rather than hide it.
I may start many projects because new things excite me, and then lose interest.
I like setting goals and achieving results.
When I feel threatened, I can become distrustful, defensive, or overly watchful.
Sometimes I compare myself to others and feel they have something I lack.
I feel I have a particular identity that sets me apart from others.
I strongly defend people I consider vulnerable.
I can imagine negative scenarios even when everything seems fine.
Sometimes I put my own needs aside to keep the peace.
I can get stuck in feelings of sadness, nostalgia, or being misunderstood.
I make an effort to do things right, even if no one will recognize it.
When I have a problem, my first reaction is usually to withdraw and think.
I find it hard to show vulnerability in front of others.
Sometimes I give a lot and then feel disappointed if I don't get recognition or affection in return.
I'm good at preparing for problems before they happen.
I may postpone decisions or problems, hoping the situation will resolve itself.
I need to feel that my life has authenticity and personal meaning.
I'm very hard on myself when I make a mistake.
I like creating calm and harmonious environments.
It really hurts to feel that someone I love doesn't need me.
I like to understand deeply how things work.
I have a strong sense of right and wrong.
I feel that other people's demands can drain too much of my energy.
I can worry too much about projecting an image of success.
I find it easy to understand different points of view.
I prefer to observe and analyze before taking part.
When something makes me suffer, I may quickly look for another activity to distract myself.
It comes naturally to me to notice what other people need.
Sometimes I feel I have to correct, improve, or control things so they work properly.
I usually find alternatives when a problem comes up.
I can adapt to different situations to get what I set out to achieve.
I value loyalty and trust very highly.

dilemmas.instruction: In each group, choose the statement that is most like you and the one that is least like you.
